about: Two painting scripts whose full-size paintings stopped on a stroke a few cells big, each cut down to the passage that failed (its own text, unchanged) with the script's sheet, palette, brushes and lights. Sheet 1086 cells across (0.26 mm a cell). See tiny-touch.mjs. The lanes of a wash are laid differently since the paintings that failed (script-marks.mjs sweeps: lapped, fanned, a short part along its own length), so the strokes that stopped them are no longer made: each case's `stroke` is the tiny touch its passage has under the lanes as they are laid now, `failed` what the painter said when it stopped (history), and `alongItsLength` is the L2 passage that failed, which is now laid along each part's own length and has no tiny touch.
